topic_title: 지하철에서 다른 승객을 배려하며 짐 관리하기

completion_requirements.completion_definition: Both basic and application have reached their learning-end flow, including explanation acknowledgment (after direct success or final answer reveal).
completion_requirements.success_definition: direct_correct means solved in up to 4 valid attempts without revealing final answer
completion_requirements.answer_reveal_definition: On 4th valid wrong attempt, user views correct answer; mark direct_correct=false
completion_requirements.unknown_or_unfinished_outcome_policy: No first topic completion and no reward until both outcomes are final.
completion_requirements.first_direct_rule: both basic and application direct_correct=true on first learning completion
completion_requirements.first_answer_reveal_rule: on first completed topic, at least one basic/application learning end result has answer_revealed=true
completion_requirements.review_rule: topic already contains first_completion_at, no additional reward
completion_requirements.persist_atomicity: Check topic first-completion + create first grant event + apply XP delta in ONE database transaction; unique constraint on idempotency key.
completion_requirements.resuming_completed_topic: Return saved first-completion status; no duplicate XP award, even after app restart/re-entry.
completion_requirements.already_completed_topic_with_both_direct: REVIEW takes precedence once grant exists

runtime_user_data_contract.level_up_when: only if the user-level service detects a threshold crossing
